note: All examples below are synthetic and redacted. No real names, phone numbers, account numbers, OTPs, or addresses are used. Placeholder tokens like [NUMBER], [LINK], [NAME], [BANK] stand in for real values.

scam_examples.text: Dear customer, your KYC has expired and your account will be suspended within 24 hours. Click [LINK] immediately to update your KYC and avoid suspension.
URGENT: Your [BANK] KYC is incomplete. Share your OTP sent to your registered mobile now to reactivate your account or it will be blocked permanently.
This is a final notice from [APP] Loans. You have defaulted. Pay [NUMBER] immediately via [LINK] or we will contact everyone in your phone contacts and inform your employer.
We have shared your photo with your contacts as a defaulter. Pay the pending amount now through [LINK] to stop further action.
Your parcel is held at customs due to unpaid duty of [NUMBER]. Pay now via [LINK] within 2 hours or the parcel will be returned.
Delivery failed due to incomplete address. A re-delivery fee of [NUMBER] is required. Pay here: [LINK]
Join our exclusive trading group. Members are earning 30% guaranteed monthly returns. Limited slots left, deposit now via [LINK] to start.
Our AI trading bot doubled [NAME]'s investment in 10 days. Send [NUMBER] to this account to begin, guaranteed profit, no risk.
This is [NAME], Cyber Crime officer. A case has been registered against your Aadhaar number for money laundering. Stay on this video call and do not disconnect or you will be arrested immediately.
Your bank account is linked to a narcotics case. To avoid arrest, transfer funds to this RBI verification account for a safety check within 1 hour.
Congratulations, you are shortlisted for a work-from-home data entry job paying [NUMBER]/month. Pay a one-time registration fee of [NUMBER] to confirm your seat.
HR Team: Your interview is confirmed. Please pay a refundable security deposit of [NUMBER] via [LINK] to receive your offer letter today.
Dear consumer, your electricity will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM due to unpaid bill. Contact our officer immediately on [NUMBER] or update payment via [LINK].
Your last month bill was not updated due to a technical fault. Download our app [LINK] and install it to avoid disconnection and get your bill corrected.
This is [BANK] Security Dept. We noticed a suspicious login. Share the OTP sent to your number to block the unauthorized transaction immediately.
Your debit card will be blocked today. Click [LINK] to verify your card number, expiry, and CVV to keep it active.
To resolve your failed transaction, please install [APP] remote support app and share the access code so our technician can fix it from our end.
You have won [NUMBER] in the [BRAND] lucky draw. Pay a processing fee of [NUMBER] to [LINK] to claim your prize within 24 hours.

genuine_examples.text: Dear customer, a debit of [NUMBER] was made on your [BANK] account ending [NUMBER] on [DATE] at [MERCHANT]. If this wasn't you, call the number on the back of your card.
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: Standard transaction alert with no link, no OTP request, no urgency beyond a normal fraud-reporting instruction pointing to the card itself rather than an unofficial channel.

genuine_examples.text: Your [BANK] statement for [MONTH] is ready. Log in to the [BANK] mobile app or netbanking portal to view it.
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: Routine notification directing the user to the bank's own app/portal, not an external link.

genuine_examples.text: Your account balance is below [NUMBER]. Maintain minimum balance to avoid a charge next cycle.
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: Informational, no request for credentials, OTP, or payment via a third-party link.

genuine_examples.text: Your electricity bill of [NUMBER] for [MONTH] is generated. Due date is [DATE]. Pay via the official [PROVIDER] app or website.
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: References the provider's own official app/website rather than an unfamiliar link, and gives a normal due date rather than an artificial countdown.

genuine_examples.text: Reminder: your water bill payment of [NUMBER] is due on [DATE]. No action needed if already paid.
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: Plain reminder, explicitly says no action needed if already paid, no threat of same-day disconnection.

genuine_examples.text: Your order #[NUMBER] has been shipped and is expected to arrive by [DATE]. Track it in the [COURIER] app.
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: Standard shipping update pointing to the courier's own app, no fee requested.

genuine_examples.text: Delivery attempted for order #[NUMBER] but no one was available. It will be re-attempted tomorrow between 10am-6pm.
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: No payment request, no link, just a scheduling update.

genuine_examples.text: [NUMBER] credited to your [BANK] account ending [NUMBER] via UPI from [NAME] on [DATE].
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: A credit notification, not a request for the user to do anything; scams almost always ask for action, this doesn't.

genuine_examples.text: You have successfully paid [NUMBER] to [MERCHANT] via UPI. Reference ID [NUMBER].
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: Confirmation of a payment the user already initiated, standard reference ID, no follow-up action requested.

genuine_examples.text: Your [BANK] credit card statement is generated. Total due: [NUMBER]. Minimum due: [NUMBER]. Due date [DATE]. Pay via netbanking, UPI autopay, or the [BANK] app.
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: Lists the bank's own official payment channels rather than a single unfamiliar link, standard statement cadence.

genuine_examples.text: Your fixed deposit of [NUMBER] matures on [DATE]. It will be auto-renewed unless you visit your branch or use netbanking to change instructions.
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: Informational with a standard official channel for changes, no urgency or threat.

genuine_examples.text: As per RBI guidelines, please complete your periodic KYC update by visiting your nearest [BANK] branch or through the official [BANK] mobile app before [DATE].
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: References an official process with a reasonable deadline and official channels (branch/own app), not a same-day threat or unfamiliar link.

genuine_examples.text: Your KYC update request has been received and is under process. It may take 5-7 working days.
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: Purely informational status update, no request for action or sensitive data.

genuine_examples.text: OTP for your transaction of [NUMBER] at [MERCHANT] is [NUMBER]. Valid for 10 minutes. Do not share this OTP with anyone.
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: This is the bank delivering an OTP to the user for a transaction the user initiated, and explicitly warns not to share it — the opposite pattern of a scam asking the user to share an OTP.

genuine_examples.text: Your health insurance premium of [NUMBER] is due on [DATE]. Pay through the official [INSURER] app, website, or your agent.
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: Standard premium reminder with legitimate official channels listed, reasonable due date.

genuine_examples.text: [BANK] app has been updated with new security features. Update to the latest version from the Play Store or App Store for a better experience.
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: Points to the official app stores rather than a direct APK/side-load link, no urgency.

genuine_examples.text: Your delivery OTP for order #[NUMBER] is [NUMBER]. Share this with the delivery agent only at the time of delivery to confirm receipt.
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: A delivery-confirmation OTP shared in a specific, limited, expected context (at the door, with the delivery agent) rather than being solicited remotely by someone claiming to be an official.

genuine_examples.text: Your EMI of [NUMBER] for loan account ending [NUMBER] is due on [DATE]. Ensure sufficient balance to avoid a bounce charge.
genuine_examples.why_legitimate: Routine EMI reminder from an existing, known loan relationship, no threats or contact-list references.
